python 2>/dev/null << 'EOF'
import re

# Try different patterns
patterns = [
    r'a\s*([^ ]+) .*? c',
    r'a\s*([^ ]+).*? c',   # no space before .*?
    r'a\s*([^ ]+)\s+.*?c',  # require whitespace after capture
]

text = " a b c "

for p in patterns:
    print(f"Pattern: {p!r}")
    m = re.search(p, text)
    if m:
        print(f"  -> group(1)={m.group(1)!r}")
    else:
        print(f"  -> NO MATCH")
EOF
